description: This file contains power management and low power mode configuration code for NXP i.MX RT11xx series processors, including core power state transitions, GPC configuration, DCDC setup, and system sleep handling.

methods.name: gpc_set_core_mappings
methods.description: Configures core power state mappings for Cortex M4 and M7 cores based on compile-time configuration.

methods.name: gpc_set_transition_flow
methods.description: Sets up GPC transition steps for various low power modes and transitions.

methods.name: gpc_configure_interrupts
methods.description: Configures GPC interrupt sources, specifically enabling system timer interrupts.

methods.name: gpc_init
methods.description: Initializes GPC settings including core mappings, transition flow, and interrupts.

methods.name: dcdc_init
methods.description: Initializes the DCDC power converter with power-saving configurations.

methods.name: system_enter_sleep
methods.description: Enters low power sleep mode (WAIT or STOP) based on specified GPC mode.

methods.name: cpu_mode_transition
methods.description: Transitions CPU to specified low power mode and manages sleep entry.

methods.name: pm_state_set
methods.description: Handles system request to enter a low power state, managing set points and CPU modes.

methods.name: pm_state_exit_post_ops
methods.description: Performs cleanup after exiting low power mode, restoring interrupts and logging previous states.

methods.name: rt11xx_power_init
methods.description: System initialization function for power management, setting voltage and initializing GPC and DCDC.
